_notes: Engine matches a club fixture to a window if the fixture DATE falls within window.range (inclusive) OR its round is listed in window.rounds.
Fill 'unavailable' from named squads (~Mon before each game). player must match the name string in nrl_player_logs.json exactly.
state: NSW | QLD. position is the player's CLUB position (drives which depth-chart slot the beneficiary uplift lands on).
Leave 'beneficiaries' empty to let the tool auto-resolve the replacement from the latest lineup/depth chart; add entries here only to override.
haircut = confidence multiplier applied to props of players in the SAME club whose role shifts (not the OUT player — they're flagged OUT, projection suppressed).
